title: GTA 6 Running Log
summary: A running, topic-organised log of GTA 6 facts from our chats plus researched codes, locations, and secrets. Progress: Chapter 1, up to Discharge Time. Updated 23 Nov 2026, 8:15 AM AEST.
calloutBody: Items marked Our chats came from Tyas in this conversation and are listed exactly as given. Items with a link were added from post-launch guides and should be treated as community-sourced until confirmed in-game. Ordinary store-robbery keypad codes are randomised and are not listed. This page was built as the first research update on 21 Nov 2026, Australia/Brisbane.

properties.label: Official patches
properties.value: None published as of 23 Nov 2026; latest build is still 01.002.001 (16 Nov, pre-launch)

footer: This is a living log. Future updates should edit this same Page rather than creating a new one.

categories.heading: Codes
categories.caption: Safe, door, and keypad codes. Tyas's three Port Gellhorn codes match launch guides. Mission codes are generally fixed; free-roam store safes are not.

items.note: Office in the northeast corner; enter the leading zero. Also on the Brooks Boatworks wall map.
Main warehouse safe, Port Gellhorn. Upstairs wall map here also reveals the other two Port Gellhorn codes.
Port Gellhorn illegal operation. Shown on the Brooks Boatworks wall map.
Key Lento shop that fronts the acid lab, Chapter 1 mission Lab Fees. Clerk tells you, or it is on a notepad.
Key Lento fence drop, unlocked in Lab Fees. Green icon on the map.

items.location: CLEAVES
items.note: Pelican Valley research outpost. Turn power on outside; password is written on a side-room floor.
Double the successful specimen ID 0036 from the lab report. Cash and the dock code are inside.
Code is inside the outpost safe; opens the dock building that holds the Crabshack VF5.
Vice City, small back office. Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3); buffalo skull chain.
Downtown Vice City, northeast corner of the middle room. Diamond ring.
Vice City rear room; enter the leading zero. Amethyst necklace.
The Hamlet, room next to the garage; code is written on the wall.
Five-digit code on a sandbar-island trailer south of Cottonmouth Lake (one guide also says Key Lento). Code is among the postcards.

Northeast of Cottonmouth Lake; basement door to an underground facility. Do not confuse with a separate dream-puzzle keypad. Gameta (21 Nov) says the alien-bunker keypad here takes the code from your own UFO dream, which differs per game (players got 1324, 2314, 3142), and no wall code works before the dream.
Leonard County, back room behind a red door. Listed as confirmed by Consolyte; not on every two-source roundup.
Wall panel, during the mission First Impressions. Consolyte listing; not on every two-source roundup.
Kingfishers Illegal Operation, north of Cottonmouth Lake. VICE's author says every code in its list was tested in-game.
Final Chapter Illegal Operation at McKittrick Farm.
San4San Illegal Operation.
Guardia Brothers Illegal Operation.
Guardia Brothers Illegal Operation; separate from the Saber Shipping Yard.
Guardia Brothers Illegal Operation; separate from the Saber Shipping Facility.
San4San weed garage, La Perle, Vice City; back-office safe. Garage also holds the Pink Gin Tulip and San4San KZ-59.
Six digits. Keypad door to the back office, Black Eagle warehouse, Balsero, Vice City.
Six digits, leading zero. Office safe holds the Black Eagle Import Kalinga .50.
Farm west of Manifest Canyon, Kelly County. Clue: ManlyGaze magazine in the big barn loft (climb the blue tractor). Opens the Applesauce Bobcat garage.
Side door of a garage in Grayson, Leonard County; number is on plaques in the house next door. Moses's '74 Vamos.
Wall keypad by the roller door; code is in messages on Boobie's laptop (Chapter 3). Holds Vanessa's Growler.
Final Chapter clubhouse at The Thirsty Wolf bar.
Back office, Balsero, Vice City; get in through the roof hatch.
Manager's office at the Delights club, Chapter 2 mission Afternoon Delight; Vicki texts the code.
Six digits. Ground-floor safe in the haunted Marbelle Hotel, south Crosstown, Vice City; code is circled on the notepad on the roof after the Silent Hill fog sequence.
La Polilla Negra stash on Bobcat Key near Watson Bay; ground-floor computer note logs the code. Upstairs lounge safe; explosives also work.

items.location: Muffins-Queen-15
items.note: Chapter 3 apartment; clues are a photo of Muffins the dog, a book and a Class of '15 reunion notebook. Messages give the La Perle garage code 92665.

categories.heading: Weapon Locations
categories.caption: Unique or notable pickups. Guides say unique variants stay unlocked and can be recovered from an Ammu-Nation locker. There are many more in the world than are listed here.

items.location: Kingpin Bowling, pool table, northeast corner
items.note: Unique pump-action shotgun. One of three valuables for the Let's Go Bowling trophy; unlocked after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

items.location: Brooks Boatworks, room with the wall map
items.note: Unique assault rifle on the table in front of the whiteboard, same room as the Port Gellhorn code map.

items.location: Pelican Valley crab research outpost, dock building
items.note: Unique SMG beside a body after using codes CLEAVES, 0072, then 0212. Available in Chapter 1.

items.location: Ruined cabin, Pelican Valley swamps
items.note: On the blood-covered cabin floor; the Cruel Huntsman's SM-69 is on the back porch of the same cabin.

items.location: Same Pelican Valley cabin, back porch
items.note: Unique sniper; grab nearby sniper ammo before leaving. Watch for alligators.

items.location: Trunk of Donnie's Dinka Blista, mission Don Gone
items.note: Missable: take it from the trunk before you destroy the car. Don Gone is Chapter 1 mission 18, so this may already be past.

items.location: Roadside encounter south of Hamlet, near Grassrivers
items.note: Help two hunters (one injured), return their truck, and take the injured hunter to hospital to receive this sniper.

items.location: Industrial storage building south of Hamlet, near the highway
items.note: Unique shotgun in a weapon case inside; cash is on a nearby table and in a yellow toolbox. Space4Games places it in Hamlet Storage, round the back of Hamlet Pawn.

items.location: Waterfront building, Kingfishers fishing compound, Wetman Bay
items.note: Scoped, suppressed small-game rifle in a case on a desk; approach the docks by boat.

items.location: Underground bunker under an antenna-covered RV, Balsero junkyard
items.note: Southwest of Griffin Shooting Range. KeenGamer says this opens after a Chapter 1 job it names Building a Life, which is not on the main mission lists.

items.location: Same Balsero bunker
items.note: Free rocket launcher with four rockets, plus other supplies in the same hatch.

items.location: Derelict spy vessel, southern tip of the southeastern Permit Keys island
items.note: Through the hatch in the middle of the deck, east of Mile Zero Air Station.

items.location: Northernmost Permit Keys island, in the sand beside a tilted smuggler boat
items.note: Unique shotgun lying outside the hull; no hidden compartment needed.

items.location: Underwater off the northern coast of Riquezas Keys
items.note: Dive at the floating drug packages to a sunken speedboat; the unique AR is beneath it.

items.location: Bobcat Bight, Capri Island, Mariana County
items.note: Shoot the lines of a paramotor caught in coastal pines, then loot the wreckage on the ground.

items.location: Bret Vogel hunting quest, Lummox County
items.note: Chapter 2 after Coffee Break: Jason gets a message from Bret and receives this sniper when Veteran Hunted starts.

items.location: Sunrise Motel, Tequesta, Vice-Dale County
items.note: Unique assault rifle in the one-car garage off the courtyard, behind a stack of toilet paper.

items.location: La Cascara Motel, Port Gellhorn, top floor
items.note: Unique SMG in an open weapon case in a guarded top-floor room during the Kolt & Associates robbery.

items.location: Dino Golf, off SR-32 in Frogswater, Kelly County
items.note: Unique baseball bat inside the batting cages on the right of the abandoned dinosaur mini-golf.

items.location: Manatee Motel, south of Hamlet, north-east of Cottonmouth Lake
items.note: Unique sniper in a weapon case in the room next to the tiger attack, with Molotovs and cash.

items.location: Off Tanglewood Lane, Port Gellhorn
items.note: Shoot down the couch hanging from a tree, then sit on it to get this unique revolver.

items.location: Black Eagle warehouse, Balsero, Vice City; safe in the keypad office
items.note: Unique Kalinga .50 pistol. Door 789987, safe 031462 (see Codes).

items.location: Same Black Eagle warehouse, through the garage and past the barred door behind the cargo truck
items.note: Lucia only: squeeze between the boxes and the fence.

items.location: House on the northwest coast of Key Lento, second-floor back-bedroom bathroom
items.note: Unique shotgun; break in from the outdoor stairs.

items.location: Yellow Scoop container, Port Vice City cargo area
items.note: Climb the container stack and break in.

items.location: Yellow Scoop container, north end of the Port Vice City cargo area
items.note: Unique LMG; come in from the water to avoid guards.

items.location: Sunlite Motel, Shore Drive, Ocean Beach; bloody doorway on the second floor
items.note: Unique SMG on the floor of a crime scene.

items.location: Just inside a bunker in Big Pine, North Mariana County
items.note: Enter from the southwest.

items.location: Seabed of Gulf Leonida, west of Bobcat Key
items.note: Three floating bodies mark the spot; needs diving.

items.location: Trunk of a blue car stuck in a mudslide off the coastal road, Bonanza
items.note: Unique Shrewsbury Drifter.

items.location: Stash House, north Port Gellhorn, just east of Brooks Boatworks
items.note: Illegal Operation loot; easy add-on to a Brooks Boatworks raid.

items.location: Next to a sunken car in south-west Kalaga Reservoir (luggage on the bank marks it)

items.location: Trunk of a car in an old barn at a dead-end road, Bonanza
items.note: Unique revolver; use the barn's side door.

items.location: Fireplace of the ruined Outlaw's Cabin, just north of Moreau, Lummox County
items.note: Unique Duke heavy pistol with an 'M&L' grip; enter through the cellar on the south-east side. Bonnie and Clyde nod (Martha and Lyle).

items.location: Floor of a mobile home on the south bank of the Moreau River, East Lummox County
items.note: Unique Duke Arms 1992 pistol.

items.location: Couch of a mobile home on the south bank of the Moreau River, East Lummox County
items.note: Second unique 1992 in the same trailer area as the Deadringer.

items.location: Back of an abandoned yellow train car on the north bank of a river, Moreau

items.location: Near a hunting platform in the woods east of Kalaga Reservoir
items.note: Unique Laird 350 sporting sniper.

items.location: Nightstand in room 115 of the Big Day Motel, off US-35 north of Ambrosia

items.location: Roof of the tallest building on Northside Ave (the one with the helipad), Washington Beach

items.location: Reward for the Dethrone the Pretender ritual (Circles of Hell House, north Port Gellhorn, at night)

items.location: Reward for surviving the Hyde Island hunt (north end of Leonida)

items.location: Gun case in the upstairs lounge, Palmer Fishing Warehouse, Bobcat Key near Watson Bay

items.location: Red boxcar on a freight train leaving the oil refinery and rail yard on SR-45

categories.heading: Valuable Locations
categories.caption: Watches, cash, pills, and other loot worth coming back for.

items.location: Casa de Empeño, Richardson Jewelry, Donovan Banks & Co.

items.location: Marbelle Hotel safe (955214), south Crosstown, Vice City

items.location: Upstairs lounge, Palmer Fishing Warehouse, Bobcat Key

items.location: Locked second-floor room of the Evergreen cabin, west side of Lake Tallaloko

items.location: Beached ship, north end of the south-western Featherstone Island, off Lummox County
items.note: Crate with cash and a Beached Cargo tattoo magazine; Jack of Hearts MonaLi$a (Silver) card in the control room.

items.location: Beach just south-west of Gellhorn Raceway, Kelly County

categories.heading: Easter Eggs and Hidden Content
categories.caption: Secrets and references. Arthur's hat, Dexter's apartment, the ASSMAN Phoenix, the Penumbra FF, and the painted-egg nest were requested; the rest are researched additions.

items.location: Yard sale, south Port Gellhorn, blue house with balloons and an American flag
items.note: Chapter 2 only. Guides place it on Orchard Avenue, northwest of Dirt Merchants, as a Genuine Cowboy Hat on a guitar case on a white couch. Sold cheap; guides disagree on the exact price, so it is omitted here.

items.location: Trinity Apartments, Washington Island, east Vice City, near the Pay 'n' Spray and Vice Beach Top Fun Drones
items.note: Door stays locked. A kill kit (syringe, knife, tape, rope) is reported on the roof; a nearby boat is compared to the Slice of Life.

items.location: Hamlet Police Department impound, Chapter 1
items.note: Seinfeld reference on a red Phoenix when Cal sends Jason to retrieve a car.

items.location: Villa garage, Vespucci Island, Vice City
items.note: Paul Walker / Fast and Furious nod with a HAD YOU plate; trunk has a Toy Story snake gag.

items.location: Top of Vice City's tallest radio / cell tower (Game8 also says South Vice-Dail County)
items.note: About a 6 to 7 minute climb. Pick up a painted egg and throw it to trigger a short cutscene below.

items.location: Road near the Starlet Motel, Kelly County
items.note: After about 2 am, a parked car with flashing lights and open doors marks the trail; it isn't there every night. Getting abducted unlocks The Truth Is Out There trophy and starts the alien chain.

items.location: Swamps near Cottonmouth Lake, south of Hamlet
items.note: Free-roam encounter reported by several outlets.

items.location: Open water, for example Gambit Bay

items.location: Northeast of Cottonmouth Lake, downstairs locked door

items.note: Unlocked in Chapter 3 (Here, Kitty Kitty).

items.location: Little Cuba, Vice City; shop, immediate sale
items.note: Unlocked in Chapter 3 (Boobie Time). After two Payday Loan jobs, garage pickup is available for a fee.

items.location: Garage in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County
items.note: Vehicle buyer, unlocked in the Chapter 2 mission Moses.

items.location: Balsero, Vice City
items.note: High-end vehicle buyer, unlocked in Chapter 3.

items.location: Key Lento
items.note: Mod shop; one guide used it to change headlights and bodywork on Jason's truck.

items.location: Multiple, including north of Brooks Boatworks in Port Gellhorn
items.note: Respray and register stolen cars; also the landmark used to place Brooks Boatworks and Dexter's block.

items.location: Multiple towns
items.note: Buy sticky bombs and refill body armor; unique weapons can be retrieved from lockers once unlocked.

items.location: Near Dirt Merchants, Port Gellhorn
items.note: Racing shop close to the dirt-bike shop, per the Dirt Merchants map card.

items.location: Hamlet
items.note: Sells the unique Sand Storm ES9 pistol for $1,470.

items.location: Mariana County
items.note: Mod shop specialising in American muscle cars.

items.location: Kelly County
items.note: Off-road car mod shop.

items.location: Vice-Dale County
items.note: Tuner and street-racing mod shop.

items.location: Vice-Dale County
items.note: Luxury-car mod shop.

items.location: Vice-Dale County
items.note: Wraps and liveries (the Halloween House car unlocks one here).

items.location: Lummox County
items.note: Classic American motorcycle mod shop.

items.location: South Southside, South Vice-Dale County, Vice City (stars-and-stripes awning)
items.note: Phil Cassidy nod. Sells the exclusive Star Spangled 556 ($3,050) and Honky Tonk Mustang .357 ($3,780).

items.location: Hold D-pad Left
items.note: Also holds windows, hazards, trunk or tailgate, and vehicle-specific options such as a pickup tailgate.

items.location: Vehicle tab: Automatic, Low Beam, High Beam, or Off
items.note: Same hold-Left menu as above; right stick up if you land on Radio first.

items.location: Tap Circle (PS5) or B (Xbox)
items.note: Some guides say a short tap toggles lights; a hold ducks instead. Use the menu for high beams.

items.location: Tap D-pad Left or Right
items.note: A tap signals; holding Left opens the menu instead.

items.location: Click L3 (PS5) or left stick (Xbox) in a police vehicle
items.note: Toggles the siren and light bar together. Left stick up is the manual siren tone; down is the horn. No confirmed lights-only toggle.

items.location: Front parking lot
items.note: Grab a vehicle and lose the two-star wanted level.

items.location: Rear fence
items.note: Quiet way out of the bowling alley compound.

items.location: Click L3 + R3
items.note: Highlights nearby notes, maps, and keypad clues. You can also aim at an employee and ask for a safe code.

items.location: Sticky bombs, or the right-stick crack prompt
items.note: Explosives can damage some contents and will alert enemies. Many operation sites have bomb crates nearby, or buy them at Ammu-Nation.

items.location: Written on-site each time
items.note: GameSpot found ordinary store and robbery keypad codes change between visits, so lists cannot give those numbers.

items.location: Fences listed under Shops
items.note: Some pay at a drop box later, others pay immediately. You can also send your partner to fence goods for a smaller cut.

items.location: Finish the main story at least once
items.note: Then open the phone, hold L1 + R1, and enter a D-pad sequence. Using a cheat disables saving afterwards. Many cheats also need a challenge completed.

items.location: $250,000: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right
items.note: The only money cheat GameSpot lists. Story must already be finished; do not use it if you still want to save.

items.location: Stash under Jason's bedroom floor, or BuckMe once you have the account
items.note: Carried cash is lost if you are killed or busted.

items.location: Outdoor wall ATMs; tow truck behind the Atomic auto parts yard, Hamlet (SE of Boone Speedway)
items.note: Hook the ATM, drive forward, reverse, forward, then finish on foot; about $7,200 marked bills on one run. Dye packs can ruin the take.

items.location: Map > Vehicles > Mod Shops (area must be uncovered)
items.note: 14 shops, each a specialist; repair a damaged car first. Mods on Jason's Chapter 1 car are lost when the story replaces it.

items.location: Hold Circle (PS5) / B (Xbox) on the main menu
items.note: Tapping only backs up one level; holding leaves the wardrobe, gun shop or garage loadout.

items.location: Check your registered personal car's trunk
items.note: Bags can be auto-moved there when you get in a car or after a cutscene; a bag badge on the car's map icon shows it.

steps.title: Open the vehicle menu
steps.detail: While in a vehicle, hold D-pad Left. If Radio opens first, push the right stick up to switch to the Vehicle tab.

steps.title: Headlights and the light bar
steps.detail: In the Vehicle tab, set Headlights to Automatic, Low Beam, High Beam, or Off. In a police vehicle, click L3 (PS5) or the left stick (Xbox) to toggle the siren and light bar together.

steps.title: Kingpin Bowling escape
steps.detail: Front parking lot for a car getaway, or stealth out via the rear fence. Leaving triggers a two-star wanted level.

categories.heading: Glitches and Bugs
categories.caption: Every entry from the scan file /workspace/gta6-glitches/seen.json (44 entries, file updated 22 Nov 2026, 6:08 PM AEST), plus extra reports found by research. No official Rockstar patch notes or known-issues list as of 23 Nov 2026, Australia/Brisbane. Latest reported official build remains 01.002.001 (16 Nov, pre-launch). A 1.002.002 report is unofficial and unconfirmed.

items.item: Prologue: Lucia falls through the map after being tased
items.location: Prologue arrest, PS5 / Xbox Series
items.note: Often teleports back to the police sequence; otherwise restart or replay the mission.

items.item: Gone Fishing: boat ram has no NPC or vehicle reaction
items.location: Gone Fishing
items.note: Ramming a speedboat into an NPC boat produced no crash, capsize, or reaction.

items.item: Gone Fishing: missing plane door / clip into seat
items.location: Gone Fishing, getaway plane
items.note: No door-opening animation; Jason clips through the fuselage into the pilot seat.

items.location: Using a fridge
items.note: A can or bottle pops into existence instead of coming off a shelf.

items.item: Stolen plane crash: no explosion, unharmed exit
items.location: Police chase in a large plane
items.note: Planes slide through buildings without exploding. Usually the Reduced Vehicle Damage option (Settings > Gameplay, off by default); turn it off and planes explode, though big jets keep the fuselage intact.

items.location: Fight with an officer, reported in a station / around a couch
items.note: Characters overlap and get sucked into furniture or a wall; reports say letting it play out usually frees you.

items.location: Hitting a swing set or similar object
items.note: Vehicle can be launched a long way and wrecked. Not confirmed as a repeatable exploit.

items.location: Jumping out of a plane early
items.note: Abandoned plane can lose physics and phase through buildings.

items.item: Survive a plane bailout with no parachute or damage
items.location: Police chase, jumping with no chute
items.note: Player lands unharmed; in the reported clip the plane itself does explode.

items.item: Lucia falls through terrain, dies, respawns elsewhere
items.location: Free roam / terrain clip
items.note: Related to, but described differently from, the prologue taser clip. Exact trigger not clearly documented.

items.location: Several early clips, mixed platforms
items.note: Includes a boat jammed in a Keys-style bridge, a passenger stuck in an Annis Hellion door, cage-mesh camera clip, tattoo-studio counter clip, bodies sinking into asphalt, and Lucia falling through a prison floor.

items.location: Intro / just before the prologue; reported on Xbox Series X
items.note: Vehicles and NPCs pop in and world textures go missing.

items.location: Free roam on a mobility scooter
items.note: Reported as unusually hard to crash; may be exaggerated physics rather than a classic glitch.

items.item: Ship / vehicle pop-in on a bridge
items.location: Driving on a bridge (one writeup: Drive to the radar station)
items.note: A ship or stacked vehicles appear jammed against or on the bridge, then shift oddly.

items.item: NPCs walk into walls and get stuck
items.location: Free roam, review build
items.note: Minor, not game-breaking; seen in pre-release reviews, not confirmed fixed on the launch build.

items.item: Floating coffee cup when switching characters
items.location: Safehouse character switch, review build
items.note: Shacknews reported an otherwise clean review apart from this one visual bug.

items.item: Phone in a tight spot drops Jason through the map
items.location: Squeeze between a car and a fence, then open the phone
items.note: A restart was reportedly needed; make a manual save first. Original post was not independently found by the scan.

items.item: Crashes or reboots wiping progress despite autosave
items.location: Unspecified
items.note: Reported progress loss after a crash or reboot even with autosave.

items.location: Physics / collision
items.note: A truck is launched a long distance after a collision.

items.location: PS5
items.note: Dexerto describes a glitch that lets players access first-person mode; details beyond the headline were not in the scan file.

items.location: Red barn stash; PS5 / Xbox Series
items.note: Cocaine or cash respawns after a manual save and reload if bags stay in the vehicle trunk; fence at Brian's Lockup. Unpatched in the scan file.

items.item: Coming Home: pool break with Mattia does not register
items.location: Coming Home, Xbox
items.note: Softlock when the pool shot does not register. From our chats and the scan file.

items.location: Early Lucia mission, after leaving a bank
items.note: Cutscene does not start; softlock.

items.location: In water
items.note: Swimming animation plays on the wrong axis.

items.location: Early game, under 15 minutes in
items.note: Player can get stuck inside a fenced area with no clear exit.

items.item: Boat wedged between bridge supports moves erratically
items.location: Bridge supports
items.note: Wedged boat behaves oddly.

items.item: Riderless motorbikes keep chasing after a mission reset
items.location: After a mission reset
items.note: Bikes continue the chase with no riders.

items.item: Traffic or cars vanish in front of the player
items.location: Traffic
items.note: Vehicles despawn or disappear ahead of the camera.

items.item: Xbox flickering lighting and blocky textures
items.location: Xbox Series X|S
items.note: Lighting flicker and blocky or corrupted textures.

items.item: PS5 CE-108255-1 crash in the prologue
items.location: Prologue, PS5
items.note: Crash with that error code. GamesRadar suggests updating the game; no official Rockstar notes.

items.item: NPC SUV frozen mid-air beside a Keys bridge
items.location: The Keys, elevated bridge
items.note: A traffic SUV hangs motionless in the air and despawns when you drive away.

items.item: Fishing rod falls through the boat and is lost
items.location: Fishing from a boat
items.note: The rod clips through the hull and is lost.

items.item: Prologue: cannot aim at the cashier
items.location: Prologue hold-up
items.note: LT / L2 does nothing when trying to aim at the cashier.

items.item: Gone Fishing: Jason stuck inside a cage
items.location: After the Kingfishers fight in Gone Fishing; PS5 and Xbox
items.note: Trapped in a wire-mesh cage with no exit. Workaround: retry the checkpoint, or load a save from before the mission. Found in the 21 Nov research update; not in the 20 Nov scan file.

items.item: Xbox Quick Resume unlocks the framerate
items.location: Xbox Series X, 120Hz display, version 01.002.001
items.note: Start at 60Hz, switch to 120Hz at the intro, cold-boot another game, then resume: 60+ FPS but gameplay runs at double speed. Game Rant also reports the 30 FPS lock lifting to about 60 FPS.

items.location: Flooded swamp yard, PS5
items.note: An alligator glides high above the water for several seconds. Harmless; unconfirmed, unpatched as of 21 Nov.

items.location: Apollo Aggregates warehouse, South Vice-Dale County
items.note: Loot about $8,000, store it in the car, save and load to warp home, then cash out at Brian's; a video claims about $4,000 per five minutes.

items.location: Stores near Jason's house
items.note: Rob them, lose the cops, start any story mission, choose Restart Mission at the cutscene, then quit: the stores reopen with new loot.

items.item: PS5 black flickering boxes and broken water
items.location: Base PS5, all gameplay
items.note: Camo-like black boxes flicker over the screen and water turns into blocks. Try updates, VRR/120Hz off, Safe Mode rebuild. Unconfirmed.

items.item: Unwanted Attention: garage disguise won't register
items.location: Brian's garage, Chapter 1
items.note: Hat/glasses change doesn't tick and the door stays shut. Fixes: release L1/LB so the wheel closes, take the $150 first, or buy new clothes and restart.

items.location: End of Chapter 2, after Afternoon Delight
items.note: No Move to Vice City call; check Prepare for Vice City's money target (Family Savings too). No confirmed fix.

items.location: Gym at Jason's house / a story mission
items.note: Holding LT+RT does nothing. A controller hardware reset (back pin-hole button, 5 seconds) fixed it for one PS5 player.

items.location: Pipework, PS5
items.note: Game closes when using the plunger. Setting PS5 video output to 1080p instead of Automatic fixed it for one player.

items.item: Bicycle won't move at Jason's house
items.location: Jason's house, PS5
items.note: Bike stops responding. Bunny-hop and fall off, then use another vehicle.

items.location: Any gun store, PS5 / Xbox Series
items.note: Two players lost the unique revolver after buying a standard .38. Save first; reload an earlier save to get it back.

items.item: Pickup rear plate flickers on dirt roads
items.location: Swamp back roads, chase camera
items.note: Cosmetic. Walk away until the car is off screen and come back, or restart the game.

items.item: PS5 rest mode stops quest calls (unconfirmed)
items.location: PS5, resuming from rest mode
items.note: One player says story calls stop until the game is fully closed and restarted, then arrive all at once.

items.location: Reddit report, details unclear
items.note: A glitch stripped Lucia's clothes entirely; screenshots only, no trigger known.

items.location: Wardrobe at the start of Chapter 2
items.note: Clothes and hats bought in Chapter 1 vanish. Re-buy them from the Key Lento shops, which stay open.

items.item: Stash bag vanishes in a car or cutscene
items.location: Any stash bag pickup
items.note: Gone from map and trunk though the money screen may count it; usually moved to your registered car's trunk.

items.item: Stuck in wardrobe / gun shop / loadout menu
items.location: Customisation screens
items.note: Mostly input: hold Circle / B instead of tapping it.

items.item: Phone apps won't open except BuckMe
items.location: Jason's phone, Xbox
items.note: Apps show 'unavailable'; keep pressing the app until it opens.

items.location: Prologue (boat sequence, intro cutscene, after the escape)
items.note: Confirmed on both consoles. One Xbox fix: play via Xbox Cloud Gaming. See also the PS5 CE-108255-1 entry.

items.item: Meet the Heders: crates can't be used
items.location: Dockyard, Meet the Heders
items.note: Lucia won't interact and the mission stalls; Pause > Restart Mission fixed it.

items.item: Chapter 3: Jason greyed out after Missing Persons
items.location: Kelly County Missing Persons case
items.note: Stuck as Lucia with no mission. Load a manual save from before the final Port Gellhorn warehouse meeting.

items.item: No Raul call after Photo Shoot / Heavy Lifting
items.location: Chapter 4 story calls
items.note: Usually an unfinished task: finish and sell all 3 Yasmani jewelry jobs; also fully restart the game.

items.item: Fully Catered crash at the delivery cutscene
items.location: Fully Catered, PS5 / Xbox Series
items.note: Freezes on the first frame and crashes. Load a save from before the mission was offered.

items.location: After Randy's text
items.note: Progression gate: deliver 17 wish-list cars and finish Photo/Shoot (Chapter 4), then wait for Randy's call.
